meta.name: business-case-development
meta.description: Build compelling business cases to justify investments and secure funding. Quantify benefits, assess costs, manage risks, and present compelling ROI arguments to leadership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写商业案例以争取投资和资金支持
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要向领导层论证项目价值并争取资源。
copy.tagline_en: Build business cases to justify investments and secure funding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to convince leadership of a project's value and secure resources.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你构建商业案例，包括财务分析、战略对齐和风险评估，以证明投资合理性并争取领导批准。
howto.when: 当你需要申请预算、证明技术投资合理性、规划重大举措或评估供应商方案时触发。

say.text: 请为我的客户门户现代化项目起草一份商业案例。
say.note: Claude 会按模板输出完整案例。

say.text: 帮我分析这个项目的 NPV 和 IRR。
say.note: Claude 会进行财务指标计算。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you build business cases by combining financial analysis, strategic alignment, and risk assessment to justify investments and secure leadership approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need budget approval, justify technology investments, plan major initiatives, or evaluate vendor solutions (up to 3 items; others similar).

say_en.text: Draft a business case for my customer portal modernization project.
say_en.note: Claude will output a full template.

say_en.text: Calculate NPV and IRR for this project.
